message:
🚀 Amazing PDF 2.4 is ready!

• Edit PDF like Sejda - click any text and change it (old Hindi Kruti Dev fonts converted to real Hindi)
• Passport Photo Maker - fill a whole A4 sheet with passport photos
• Word, Excel, PowerPoint to PDF and back, plus OCR for scanned papers
• Compress PDF or photo to an exact size (100 KB, 200 KB...)
• Redact PDF, Mask Aadhaar, Fill Forms, E-Signature, Invoice & Resume maker
• Smart Vault, App Lock with PIN / fingerprint, and a Share button for WhatsApp
• One-tap in-app updates - no more manual downloads

Tap OK to open the download page.
